intended_use: Inspection, management follow-up, and escalation guidance only. Not disease diagnosis, medication, vaccination, or automated treatment advice.

severity_guide.owner_instruction: Review during normal flock rounds and continue scheduled monitoring.
Verify the evidence and inspect the building within 24 hours.
Inspect during the current shift, document findings, and correct verified management or equipment deviations.
Inspect immediately and notify the responsible farm manager. Involve the veterinarian or service technician when mortality, illness, or welfare concerns are present.

rules.dashboard_action: Continue normal management and monitoring. No corrective action is indicated today.
rules.inspection_checklist: Confirm that mortality, population, feed, water, and weight records are current. Continue scheduled weighing and daily flock observation.
rules.escalation_trigger: Escalate only if the risk level rises, a forecast deteriorates materially, or staff observe a welfare or health concern.

rules.dashboard_action: Confirm the weight result, then check whether birds have unrestricted access to suitable feed and water.
rules.inspection_checklist: Reweigh a representative sample using the farm-approved method; review flock uniformity; check feed supply, feed form and quality, feeder height and space, water pressure and flow, drinker accessibility, house temperature, ventilation, lighting, and stocking density.
rules.escalation_trigger: Escalate to the farm manager, nutritionist, or service technician when the shortfall is confirmed and persists after verified management or equipment issues are corrected.

rules.dashboard_action: Review the flock and establish why mortality or survival has worsened.
rules.inspection_checklist: Reconcile bird and mortality counts; inspect bird behavior, droppings, litter, air quality, temperature, water use, feed use, and recent operational changes; record causes of culling where known.
rules.escalation_trigger: Notify the farm veterinarian or service technician when mortality continues rising, clinical signs are present, or the cause is not evident. Arrange appropriate post-mortem examination through trained personnel.

rules.dashboard_action: Treat this as a combined performance problem and complete a focused flock assessment.
rules.inspection_checklist: Verify weight and mortality data; check water and feed systems first; then review environment, litter, bird distribution, leg problems, feed quality, and recent feed or management changes.
rules.escalation_trigger: Escalate for veterinary or service-technician investigation when growth loss and survival loss occur together, particularly if mortality is increasing or birds show clinical signs.

rules.dashboard_action: Inspect this building against better-performing peers and look for a building-specific problem.
rules.inspection_checklist: Compare feed and water consumption, water pressure, feeder and drinker access, sensor readings, fan and inlet operation, temperature distribution, litter condition, lighting, stocking density, and bird distribution. Confirm that the difference is not caused by stale or incorrect records.
rules.escalation_trigger: Escalate when the building remains worse than age-matched peers after data and equipment checks, or when a health or welfare concern is observed.

rules.dashboard_action: Investigate shared inputs or conditions affecting several buildings before changing individual-building settings.
rules.inspection_checklist: Review the common feed batch or formulation, water source and pressure, water quality, controller programs, ventilation settings, weather exposure, chick source, vaccination history, and recent farm-wide operational changes.
rules.escalation_trigger: Contact the farm manager and the appropriate nutritionist, integrator, service technician, or veterinarian when a shared cause is suspected or several buildings continue deteriorating.

rules.dashboard_action: Update the missing measurement before making a major management decision.
rules.inspection_checklist: Obtain a fresh representative weight where needed; reconcile population and mortality; confirm feed and water readings; and check whether sensors or records are incomplete.
rules.escalation_trigger: Escalate the data issue when required measurements cannot be collected promptly or when missing evidence could conceal a health or welfare concern.
